title: New ransomware campaign targeting cloud infrastructure
description: Security researchers have identified a new ransomware variant specifically designed to target cloud-based infrastructure. The campaign uses compromised CI/CD pipelines to deploy malicious code.

title: Show HN: Open-source vulnerability scanner
description: New tool automatically scans dependencies for known vulnerabilities and suggests patches. Gaining traction in the security community.

title: The Give - Peer-to-Peer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all...
description: The Give - Peer-to-Peer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.9.5. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers who know or discover an existing campaign and team ID to modify the team's name, story, goal, access and notification settings, set its profile image URL, and upload WordPress-allowed media files as parentless attachments.

description: The Give - Peer-to-Peer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'sort' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.9.3 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. title: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-850L FW1.20WWb03. This impacts an unknown...
description: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-850L FW1.20WWb03. This impacts an unknown function of the file /usr/sbin/consolepwd of the component Console Login. Performing a manipulation results in hard-coded credentials. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

title: When authentication caching is enabled on DefaultLdapRealm, after a user logs in successfully...
description:
When authentication caching is enabled on DefaultLdapRealm, after a user logs in successfully once, subsequent logins for that user succeed with any password.
A cached authentication skips the LDAP bind, and the AllowAllCredentialsMatcher installed by default in DefaultLdapRealm accepts any credentials, allowing an attacker who knows a valid username to authenticate as that user.

title: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DSL-6740C 20131126. This affects an unknown function of...
description: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DSL-6740C 20131126. This affects an unknown function of the file /etc/templates/ftpd/ftpd_conf.php of the component FTP Daemon. Such manipulation leads to hard-coded credentials. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

title: A vulnerability was determined in itsourcecode Airline Reservation System 1.0. The impacted...
description: A vulnerability was determined in itsourcecode Airline Reservation System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /admin/manage_user.php. This manipulation of the argument ID causes sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

title: The Custom Block Builder  WordPress plugin before 3.0.0 does not properly deny unauthorised...
description: The Custom Block Builder  WordPress plugin before 3.0.0 does not properly deny unauthorised requests to its REST routes, as its permission checks return a non-error response that WordPress treats as granted, allowing unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary PHP code on the server.

title: The RegistrationMagic  WordPress plugin before 6.1.0.4 does not verify ownership of the submitted...
description: The RegistrationMagic  WordPress plugin before 6.1.0.4 does not verify ownership of the submitted email address before updating the associated WordPress user account, allowing unauthenticated attackers to overwrite the profile fields of arbitrary non-administrator users by submitting a public form that contains name and primary-email fields.

title: The Membership Plugin  WordPress plugin before 4.0.6 does not perform any authorization or CSRF...
description: The Membership Plugin  WordPress plugin before 4.0.6 does not perform any authorization or CSRF check before running a schema-altering database maintenance routine, allowing unauthenticated users to convert the Membership Plugin  WordPress plugin before 4.0.6's own tables to a narrower character set, which irreversibly replaces every 4-byte character (such as emoji and some CJK characters) in the membership level, discount code and payment records with a question mark.

title: The Burst Statistics  WordPress plugin before 3.7.5 does not check that a reported page view...
description: The Burst Statistics  WordPress plugin before 3.7.5 does not check that a reported page view belongs to published content, nor check post status before listing post titles and links in its public statistics output, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose the titles and permalinks of draft, pending and private posts.

title: The Burst Statistics  WordPress plugin before 3.7.5 does not enforce a shared report's date range...
description: The Burst Statistics  WordPress plugin before 3.7.5 does not enforce a shared report's date range on the analytics it serves to the report's share link, allowing anyone holding the link to read the report's statistics for any period the site retains rather than the period the report was shared for.

title: The RegistrationMagic  WordPress plugin before 6.1.0.4 does not properly escape a user-supplied...
description: The RegistrationMagic  WordPress plugin before 6.1.0.4 does not properly escape a user-supplied value before printing it inside an inline script block on several of its admin screens, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary JavaScript that executes in the session of an administrator who is tricked into opening a crafted link.

title: The Payment Gateway via Valitor for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.9.41 does not properly...
description: The Payment Gateway via Valitor for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.9.41 does not properly validate the authenticity of payment callbacks, relying on a verification secret that ships with a hard-coded default value used by every store that has not changed it, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge a valid payment confirmation and mark arbitrary orders as paid.

title: The RegistrationMagic  WordPress plugin before 6.1.0.4 does not sanitise and escape a parameter...
description: The RegistrationMagic  WordPress plugin before 6.1.0.4 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, which could allow high privilege users such as admin to perform SQL injection attacks.

title: The Membership Plugin  WordPress plugin before 4.0.6 does not verify that the membership...
description: The Membership Plugin  WordPress plugin before 4.0.6 does not verify that the membership referenced in a saved-card payment request belongs to the user making it, allowing subscriber-level members to disclose another member's Stripe payment client secret and attach a payment method of their choosing to another member's pending payment.

title: The A2Reviews WordPress plugin through 1.2.3 does not properly verify authorization on several of...
description: The A2Reviews WordPress plugin through 1.2.3 does not properly verify authorization on several of its API command handlers, relying on a signature keyed on a value that is empty by default on an unconnected install, allowing unauthenticated attackers to modify A2Reviews WordPress plugin through 1.2.3 settings and product review metadata and to read non-public product metadata.

title: The Auth Armor  WordPress plugin through 1.0.3 does not require authentication on several...
description: The Auth Armor  WordPress plugin through 1.0.3 does not require authentication on several handlers available to logged-out users, which leak the site's stored API credentials and allow an unauthenticated attacker to reset an administrator's enrollment and take over that administrator account.

title: A weakness has been identified in Linux Foundation Magma up to 1.9.0. The impacted element is an...
description: A weakness has been identified in Linux Foundation Magma up to 1.9.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file orc8r/cloud/go/services/obsidian/access/operator.go of the component Obsidian REST. Executing a manipulation of the argument X-Magma-Client-Cert-Serial can lead to authentication bypass by spoofing. The attack can be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-123507 - Vikunja from 0.24.0 before 2.7.1 contains a nil pointer dereference vulnerability that allows projec
description: Vikunja from 0.24.0 before 2.7.1 contains a nil pointer dereference vulnerability that allows project admins to break project views by saving a filter-mode bucket configuration with a null filter. Because validateProjectViewFilters skips nil entries, every subsequent read of the view panics in kanban and task collection code, returning HTTP 500 to all project members.

title: CVE-2026-123506 - Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.7.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows holders o
description: Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.7.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows holders of tokens scoped only to projects_webhooks to manage the owner's user-level webhooks by supplying user_id in request bodies. Attackers can register user webhooks to their own receiver to obtain reminders and task payloads from all owner projects, and read, change or delete existing user webhooks.

title: CVE-2026-123505 - Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an insecure file permissions vulnerability that allows local users to
description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an insecure file permissions vulnerability that allows local users to read stored data because localStorage.Write creates blobs world-readable. Local attackers on a shared host can read attachments, project backgrounds and exports, and copy the SQLite database to crack password hashes offline.

title: CVE-2026-123504 - Vikunja from 0.22.0 before 2.7.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows read-o
description: Vikunja from 0.22.0 before 2.7.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows read-only project members to view full webhook target URLs by listing project webhooks. Attackers can extract incoming-webhook tokens or API keys embedded in target_url values to post to receiving channels or reuse keys until rotated.

title: CVE-2026-123503 - Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in canDoBucket that allows use
description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in canDoBucket that allows users with project write access to delete buckets via a mismatched view ID. Attackers can request deletion through another view's bucket endpoint to bypass the last-bucket rule, leaving dangling default/done bucket references and inconsistent task buckets.

title: CVE-2026-123502 - Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that allows log readers to obtai
description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that allows log readers to obtain link-share hashes because the request logger records the raw URI of the /shares/:share/auth route. Attackers with access to Vikunja or reverse proxy access logs can reuse non-expiring, non-password-protected share hashes to obtain a project JWT with read, write or admin permission.

title: CVE-2026-123501 - Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authent
description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust server memory through concurrent image decodes in avatar and background uploads. Attackers can send several parallel tiny, highly compressible PNGs decoded at up to 50 megapixels each, pushing the API process into memory pressure or an OOM kill.

title: CVE-2026-123500 - Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an insecure file permissions vulnerability that allows local users to
description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an insecure file permissions vulnerability that allows local users to read dump archives created with umask permissions by the vikunja dump command. Local attackers on a shared host can read the world-readable zip in the rootpath to obtain config, password hashes, TOTP secrets, tokens, and stored files.

title: CVE-2026-123499 - Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows malicious reposi
description: Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows malicious repository authors to capture API tokens by specifying an attacker-controlled server in .veans.yml. When veans runs in an untrusted checkout, it sends VEANS_TOKEN as a Bearer token, or login passwords, TOTP codes and tokens, to that server, granting attackers the victim's Vikunja access.

title: CVE-2026-123498 - Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a prompt injection vulnerability that allows project members wit
description: Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a prompt injection vulnerability that allows project members with write access to inject instructions by setting project titles or task content rendered verbatim inside the coding agent's authoritative instruction block. Attackers can craft ProjectTitle or task descriptions that the prime hook loads on SessionStart and PreCompact, causing the agent to modify the developer's checkout or run commands.

title: CVE-2026-123497 - Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a protocol downgrade vulnerability in serverCandidates that allo
description: Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a protocol downgrade vulnerability in serverCandidates that allows on-path attackers to force plain HTTP during veans init and login. Attackers can block HTTPS ports so discovery accepts an unverified HTTP response, capturing passwords, TOTP codes or bot tokens and persisting cleartext API traffic.

title: CVE-2026-123496 - Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a symlink following vulnerability that allows attackers to make
description: Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a symlink following vulnerability that allows attackers to make veans init write files outside the repository via crafted repo symlinks. Attackers can ship symlinked .veans.yml, .claude, or .opencode entries to overwrite user files like ~/.bashrc or install veans hooks and plugins globally.

title: CVE-2026-123495 - Vikunja 2.0.0 before 2.7.1 accepts form-encoded bodies on the /api/v2 login and OIDC callback endpoi
description: Vikunja 2.0.0 before 2.7.1 accepts form-encoded bodies on the /api/v2 login and OIDC callback endpoints without CSRF or Origin checks, enabling login cross-site request forgery. An attacker with an account can lure a victim to a page posting the attacker's credentials or OIDC code, switching the victim into the attacker's account and exposing data the victim then adds.

title: CVE-2026-123494 - Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to im
description: Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to import their data into a victim's account because the Todoist, Microsoft To Do, and Trello migration OAuth callbacks lack a bound state parameter. Attackers can authorize their own account, keep the unused callback code or token, and lure a logged-in victim to the migration callback route to auto-import attacker-chosen projects and tasks containing phishing links.

title: CVE-2026-123493 - Vikunja from 2.4.0 before 2.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows disabled
description: Vikunja from 2.4.0 before 2.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows disabled or locked users to retain access through API tokens owned by their bot users. Because token validation only checks the bot's own status, attackers holding pre-minted bot tokens can keep reading and modifying shared projects via the HTTP API, CalDAV, MCP and feeds.
